passages.title: Comparing Arguments and Evaluating Evidence
passages.text: Two reports described the school’s science fair. Report A said participation reached 180 because it counted online registrations, including students who later stayed home. Report B recorded 142 participants because volunteers counted the people who entered the hall. A social media post claimed that one report must be false. However, the two reports measured different things. The organiser explained that both numbers could be accurate while answering different questions. A careful reader should compare the definitions before deciding whether the figures disagree.

questions.prompt: What is the main point of the passage?
choices: Reports can differ because they measure different things
Social media always checks statistics correctly
Science fairs should never count participants
questions.explanation: Perhatikan keseluruhan teks; ringkasan paling tepat harus mencakup topik serta gagasan utamanya.

choices: Laporan bisa berbeda karena mengukur hal berbeda
Media sosial selalu memeriksa statistik dengan benar
Pameran sains tidak boleh menghitung peserta

questions.evidence: Two reports described the school’s science fair.

questions.explanation: Report A mencatat semua pendaftaran daring.

questions.prompt: Why could both reports be accurate?
choices: They counted exactly the same group
They used different definitions of participation
questions.explanation: Satu laporan menghitung pendaftar dan yang lain menghitung kehadiran.

questions.prompt: What should readers do before concluding the reports contradict each other?
choices: Ask a random student to guess
questions.explanation: Pembaca perlu menelusuri arti ukuran yang dipakai.
